subject: Money
title: The Problem It Solves
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Problem It Solves.

hook.text: Sending $200 from the U.S. to Nigeria through banks costs $14 and takes 3 days. Crypto: $0.01, 10 minutes.

buildup.text: Traditional banking excludes 1.4 billion adults worldwide. They have no ID, no address, no account.

discovery.text: Crypto needs only internet access. No paperwork, no minimum balance, no bank approval. It's permissionless money.

twist.text: Most crypto adoption happens in countries with unstable currencies. In stable economies, banks work fine for most.

climax.text: Crypto solves real problems for some and creates new ones for others. Context determines whether it helps or harms.

punchline.text: A solution looking for your problem.

quiz.question: Where is cryptocurrency adoption growing fastest?
